meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把提交信息写成 Conventional Commits 格式，压缩到只剩意图，不带废话。它只输出一段可直接粘贴的消息代码块，不执行 git commit、不暂存文件、不 amend。
howto.when: 当你说「write a commit」等提交相关说法，或使用 /commit、/caveman-commit 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我写这次改动的 commit message
say.note: 按 Conventional Commits 格式输出代码块

say.text: 把这次破坏性改动写成 commit
say.note: 会带上 BREAKING CHANGE 正文

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes commit messages in Conventional Commits format, compressed to intent only, no fluff. It only outputs the message as a paste-ready code block; it never runs git commit, stages files, or amends.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'write a commit' or 'commit message', or use the /commit, /caveman-commit commands.

say_en.text: Write the commit message for this change
say_en.note: Outputs a Conventional Commits code block

say_en.text: Write a commit for this breaking change
